episodes.title: Exile
episodes.summary: Furious that her sister Simone won't return her calls, Devon heads to an island enclave to find her — and into the clutches of her controlling boss.

episodes.title: Talons
episodes.summary: Stymied by Michaela, Devon makes a bold move to remain in Simone's orbit. Simone and Michaela's bond is tested as secrets begin to surface.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: Devon gains deeper insight into Michaela's unique magnetism. With Ethan out of reach, Simone finds herself on Peter's trail instead.

episodes.title: Persephone
episodes.summary: The chaos Devon left behind in Buffalo catches up with her. Simone must decide her own future. Michaela investigates Peter's phone.

episodes.title: Siren Song
episodes.summary: As the gala kicks off, the conflict between Michaela and Simone comes to a head. Peter has a realization. Devon considers her options.
